text: This report recommends the 2023 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council’s approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Approved the following 2023 meeting dates: - Friday, March 31, 2023; - Friday, May 5, 2023; - Friday, June 23, 2023; - Friday, September 8, 2023; - Friday, October 6, 2023; and - Friday, November 3, 2023.
